# AntiBookBan

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** AntiBookBan

## What it does

Prevents kicks for reaching the packet decode limit. This can cause inventory de-sync and other issues, it's recommended you don't use it unless you are book banned.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
